nodes.label: Creator Page (video library + clean→script→dub workflow)
nodes.rationale: Turns existing videos into new ads through approval-gated steps (clean subtitles → new script → dub → result); a fit-meter matches the new script's word count to the original speaker's words/sec so lip-sync stays natural; includes a Research & Brand Agent chat. Endpoints: /api/creator/library, /api/creator/meta, /api/clean-subs, /api/clean-restore, /api/run (transcribe|dub), /api/script/{stem}, /api/copywrite, /api/chat, /api/agent-note, /api/upload, /api/jobs, /api/job/{id}/stop, /api/output-to-desktop, /api/thumb.

nodes.label: Local Claude Assistant (copywriting, spell-fix, repair advisor)
nodes.rationale: One local Claude serves many tabs: brand-compliant ad copy, caption proofreading, script rewrites fed with the full research banks + brand offer + the video's measured speaking pace, DubSync problem diagnosis from the video itself, and the Research & Brand Agent chat with pinnable memory (/api/agent-note).
